blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Southwest Maple Ridge: streets and boundaries

items.t: Southwest Maple Ridge is a board sub-area name only; the City's own name for this corner is Hammond, bounded west by Pitt Meadows and the Katzie First Nation, south by the Fraser River, and north by the Lougheed Highway and Dewdney Trunk Road commercial areas.
Port Hammond and Port Haney are the other City neighbourhood names buyers use inside and at the east edge of this sub-area.

blocks.text: Southwest Maple Ridge: the housing stock

items.t: The standard house zone is RS-1 (Single Detached Residential) in Zoning Bylaw No. 7600-2019, with subdivision minimums of 668.0 square metres lot area, 18.0 metres width and 27.0 metres depth.

blocks.text: Southwest Maple Ridge: rules that affect buyers

items.t: One secondary suite per lot is permitted inside the house, to a maximum of 40% of gross floor area, and not within the floodplain area.
A Hammond Development Permit Area applies to properties within the Hammond Area Plan, on top of the base zoning.

blocks.text: Southwest Maple Ridge: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Hammond began as Port Hammond Junction: the Hammond brothers donated land to the Canadian Pacific Railway on condition the first Maple Ridge station be built in Hammond, and the community grew around the station, yards and a cedar mill.

Hammond Park, 20577 Lorne Avenue, carries a playground, sport court, tennis court and pickleball court, while Hammond Community Park holds the Larry Walker and Hammond Stadium ballfields and the Hammond Outdoor Pool.
The Maple Ridge Golf Course, 20818 Golf Lane, is the site the rejected community park bylaw proposed to convert — it remains a golf course site after the vote.
In the escarpment policy area, City policy says septic fields are to be avoided and new residences require sanitary sewers, so confirm sewer connection on older Hammond houses.

blocks.text: Southwest Maple Ridge: development and new projects

items.t: Hammond Aquatics and Recreation Centre, 11509 207 Street and 20601 Westfield Avenue, City of Maple Ridge, recreation centre on the Hammond Community Park site, Loan Authorization Bylaw No. 8123-2026: voters rejected the borrowing on October 17, 2026, 6,841 Yes to 14,218 No — STATUS: borrowing not approved; project will not proceed as proposed, read 2026-11-03.

Hammond Multi-Use Community Park, 20818 Golf Lane, City of Maple Ridge, community park on the Maple Ridge Golf Course site, Loan Authorization Bylaw No. 8124-2026: voters rejected the borrowing on October 17, 2026, 6,209 Yes to 14,797 No — STATUS: borrowing not approved; project will not proceed as proposed, read 2026-11-03.

Golden Ears Way expansion, Golden Ears Way between the Highway 7 interchange and 210 Street, City of Maple Ridge road project: expansion from two lanes to four, with detailed design underway — STATUS: design stage, read 2026-11-03.

Buses 743 and 744 loop through Hammond streets — 207 Street, Lorne Avenue and the Hammond area — between Meadowtown and Haney Place via Maple Meadows Station, and route 701 runs on Dewdney Trunk Road at the area's north edge.
The Golden Ears Bridge at the area's west side is the road link to Langley and Surrey across the Fraser River.

blocks.text: Southwest Maple Ridge: risks and due diligence

items.t: Check the Fraser River Escarpment layer first: the policy area runs from 207 Street west to 224 Street east, 124 Avenue north to the escarpment crest south, and lots within 100 metres of the crest need a detailed geotechnical report on seismic slope failure.

Check flood construction level on any river-side lot: the level is 6.7 metres geodetic including freeboard, a covenant on title identifies floodplain construction, and the City page does not clear a specific lot.
